import hashlib,json,signal,time
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.fig01_export import first_seen_metadata
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve(); NAME='diag_fig01_witness_metadata_01'; started=time.monotonic(); sources={}
def stop(*_): raise TimeoutError('55s metadata diagnostic bound; no export/native reads')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,stop); signal.alarm(55)
def read(ref,logged=False):
 p=(ROOT/ref['file']).resolve(); b=p.read_bytes(); assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==ref['sha256'],str(p)
 if 'bytes' in ref: assert len(b)==ref['bytes']
 d=json.loads(b)
 if logged: sources[str(p)]={'file':str(p),'sha256':ref['sha256'],'metrics_sha256':d['_meta']['metrics_sha256']}
 return d
def ref(p):
 p=(ROOT/p).resolve();b=p.read_bytes();return {'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b)}
qualification={'file':'results/smoke_e2e_pilot_pool_83_certificates_01.json','sha256':'0b704d1e8c1579b1f76a968084af6e919bb65ec009abcf7d91b96e02e63d91f0'}
q=read(qualification,True); manifest=read(q['metrics']['manifest']); entries={r['dataset_key']:r for r in manifest['entries'] if r['kind']=='look_flip'}
rows=[]
for cr in manifest['cache_sources']:
 cache=read(cr,True)
 for entry in cache['metrics']['population_ledger']:
  key=entry.get('dataset_key')
  if key not in entries:continue
  source=read(entry['source'],True); matches=[r for r in source['metrics']['pairs'] if r['pair_id']==entry['pair_id']]; assert len(matches)==1
  row=matches[0]; package=read(row['source_package']); checks=read(row['detail']); header=read(entries[key]['table_manifest'])
  seen,reason=first_seen_metadata(header,entries[key]['table_manifest'],entries[key]['world_order'],checks['pair_checks'],[])
  worlds=[]
  for w,witness in enumerate(package['t01']['witnesses']):
   old=checks['pair_checks']['witness_replay'][w]
   worlds.append({'world':w,'original_witness_actions':witness.get('actions'),'action_count':len(witness.get('actions',[])), 'stored_replay':old,
      'initial_anchor_pixels':header['states'][header['initial_state']]['anchor_pixels'][w]})
  rows.append({'dataset_key':key,'pair_id':entry['pair_id'],'scene':entries[key]['scene'], 'source':entry['source'],
      'source_package':row['source_package'],'checks':row['detail'],'table_manifest':entries[key]['table_manifest'],
      'original_pair_check_passed':checks['pair_checks']['passed'],'original_min_solution_turns':checks['pair_checks']['min_solution_turns'],
      'ranking_reason':reason,'ranking_first_seen':seen,'worlds':worlds})
assert len(rows)==len(entries)==22 and len({r['dataset_key'] for r in rows})==22
failure_ref=ref('results/diag_fig01_scoped_smoke_01.json');failure=read(failure_ref,True)
metrics={'kind':'fig01_original_witness_metadata_diagnostic','metadata_only':True,'native_or_full_payload_revalidated':False,
 'qualification':qualification,'original_failure':failure_ref,'pairs':rows,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'producer_exit_code':0}
path=ROOT/'logs/review'/NAME;path.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
report=path/'report.json';report.write_text(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
result={'metrics':{**metrics,'report':ref(report)},'config':{'name':NAME,'scope':'Original22 metadata and original ranking witness masks only; no new scientific acceptance/export'},'sources':list(sources.values())}
with (ROOT/'results'/(NAME+'.json')).open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True);f.write('\n')
signal.alarm(0)
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(result['metrics'],sort_keys=True),flush=True)
